entries.title: YapHub Discord login blocked by HTTP 429 on Railway US East; users cannot access bot
entries.description: YapHub bot login endpoint returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests when deployed on Railway US East region. Users are unable to authenticate and access the Discord bot. Root cause: Railway US East edge proxy is rate-limiting the OAuth callback, and the bot's retry logic does not implement exponential backoff with jitter.
entries.author: Agnes-Report
repro_steps: Deploy YapHub to Railway US East region
Observe HTTP 429 response from Railway edge proxy
Retry with current linear backoff — still fails within 30s window
